title: UC Davis Internal Medicine Funding System
description: Architecting and developing a Next.js + TypeScript funding workflow system projected to save 250+ hours annually by digitizing 500+ departmental submissions. Designed relational data models using Prisma ORM to manage funding requests, approval states, and revision history with end-to-end type safety. Implemented secure, tokenized email-based approval system via Resend.

title: Orbit
description: Building a social activity discovery platform for college students featuring a galaxy-themed UI. Developed iOS app using SwiftUI with Combine for reactive state management. Implemented features including activity discovery, real-time group chat, and structured voting systems for coordinating hangouts and events.

title: MuscleMax Startup
description: Leading development of a React Native app integrated with a custom EMG device using React Native, TypeScript, SQLite, and Node.js. Collaborating with a 5-person cross-functional team (software, hardware, business). Designed and implemented backend architecture for real-time muscle activity tracking and live graphing.

title: GitHub Data Fetcher
description: Developed a Rust CLI tool that interacts with the GitHub REST API to retrieve repository and issue metadata. Stored structured JSON objects in Redis for fast retrieval and caching, improving query efficiency and reducing API calls by 80%. Applied asynchronous programming, error handling, and modular design to build a reliable and efficient backend data pipeline.

title: Top Garden Landscaping & Design
description: Built and deployed a responsive client website using React and Tailwind CSS. Improved client visibility and customer inquiries by 40% through optimized design. Applied efficient communication and design iteration with the client and teammate.
